# CLI response-envelope fixtures

Generated by `scripts/generate_agent_runtime_response_fixtures.py` through the
real Hermes argparse tree and command handlers against an isolated empty
runtime. `error_id` is the only normalized field.

Two families live here:

* the `work_*` envelopes, produced against an empty runtime;
* the `realm_sync_status_*` envelopes, which only exist against runtime STATE
  and so name an entry in the generator's `FIXTURE_ARRANGEMENTS` (a realm whose
  git `origin` is a path that was never created; a realm read with a credential
  issued for a different realm). Both arrangements are offline. Each case runs
  against its own isolated root, so the order of `FIXTURE_CASES` is cosmetic.

`tests/agent_runtime/test_response_contract_fixture.py` re-runs the producer for
every case and requires the committed bytes back; regenerate rather than
hand-edit.

The Launcher commits byte-identical copies under
`test/fixtures/hermes_responses/`. Regenerate and mirror them together; do not
hand-author a response shape in the consumer repo.
